entities.summary: Christopher Fogt is a United States Army Lieutenant Colonel, three-time USA Olympian, Olympic Silver medalist, and currently the head coach of the USA Bobsled Team. He won a Silver Medal at the 2014 Olympic Games in Sochi as a member of the famed Team Night Train, in the four-man event. He also competed in the two-man Bobsled event in Sochi, earning 12th place with pilot, Cory Butner. He competed in the 2010 Vancouver Games as a member of USA-2, in the four-man event with pilot John Napier.
